replay.note: A scored against stored Phase B.1 TL metrics; D against CF. FedAvg uses clipped-logit sigmoid; centralized uses sklearn predict_proba.

masking_versus_replacement.masking: Paper masking zeros one already-standardized column (the source-training mean) on a finished TL or CF matrix. A constant CF source-port column cannot reorder scores when masked.
masking_versus_replacement.replacement: Factorial C/D replace TL's originally variable source-port column with the CF sentinel before scaling. That replacement can change ranking even though masking the resulting constant cannot.
